title: Help for HDB Owners in Financial Hardship Who Are Unable to Sell Flats Due to Ethnic Integration Policy
what_it_is: Help for HDB Owners in Financial Hardship Who Are Unable to Sell Flats Due to Ethnic Integration Policy

sections.label: Aid for HDB owners
sections.summary: HDB will grant extensions, reduce or defer instalments, consider EIP flexibility, and refer hardship cases to Social Service Offices.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan
sentences.text: asked the Minister for National Development whether the Government will consider some form of financial aid to HDB owners who are unable to sell their flat due to the ethnic racial quota but need to sell their flat due to financial hardship.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Hence, for those who face difficulties, HDB will, in the first instance, grant them an extension of time to market and sell their flat.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Beyond that, if they face any financial issues, HDB will also look into reducing or deferring the monthly mortgage instalments temporarily to ease their cash flow.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For those with exceptional circumstances, HDB will consider exercising flexibility in administering the Ethnic Integration Policy (EIP).

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: More generally, households in financial hardship can avail themselves to the broader suite of Government assistance schemes and community schemes, and consider other measures to put their finances on a more stable footing.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: So, HDB will refer them to the Social Service Office for financial counselling and for other means of financial support.

sections.label: Flat price depends on attributes
sections.summary: Whether a flat sells lower than neighbours depends on its attributes, location, height, facing and linkages to amenities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: As for whether every flat is sold lower relative to the neighbours, that depends again on the attributes of the flat, the location, the height, the facing and its linkages to other amenities.
